svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V2 · SAAS LAUNCH CUT

g.text: our serum bottle, in a hand, on wet marble, morning light

svg.text: Teal-lit b-roll screen: the prompt "our serum bottle, in a hand, on wet marble" and
four generated takes; one gets the Keep button.
Takes resolve in a 2×2 from noise to image (40ms stagger). Camera eases to the kept
take, which expands to full-bleed on the cut.
"Need a shot that doesn't exist? Type it."
Granular shimmer as the takes resolve; click on Keep.
The kept take morphs into a vertical phone.
Five vertical ads on a curved carousel, coral rim light: centre phone sharp and large,
sides smaller and dimmer. HOOK / DEMO / PAYOFF labels, on-screen AI-GENERATED tags.
Carousel rotates one step per beat (3 steps). Centre phone plays; captions highlight
Three swipes, each a different voice snippet.
Phones flatten into the stat row.

g.text: PUBLISHED PRICES · NOTHING IS A STARTING-FROM FIGURE

svg.text: Four stat cards, each a single big number from the site: 3 days · 9 languages · $1.50
Numbers count up on four consecutive beats; cards rise 22px with 40ms stagger. Prices
are the site's published figures (checked 20 Sep 2026).
"Three days. Nine languages. One published price."
Mechanical counter ticks, a stamp per card.
The site's testimonial, set large: "Compared to your quality I actually like yours
more. Theirs has a cheap look." Attribution in mono.
Quote types on by phrase, not character. Slow 2% push. Everything else black.
(read by the customer, or left as text)
Music thins to pad + a single piano note.
